answer: Each answer is accompanied by a commitment to the inference that produced it: a model fingerprint plus a hash of the token logits, posted as an echo header. Producing 51 answers an epoch therefore burns 82 real forward passes, and the vine record lets any auditor recompute the check. Replaying a stored transcript fails because the challenge words differ every epoch, and fabricating a commitment fails a glacier spot-check that re-runs the prompt. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
